sql: SELECT item_id, vendor_id, vendor_name, amount_usd, CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS scheduled_date, CAST(bank_changed_at AS STRING) AS bank_changed_at, datediff(CAST(scheduled_date AS DATE), CAST(bank_changed_at AS DATE)) AS days_before, CAST(callback_confirmed_at AS STRING) AS callback_confirmed_at, callback_phone_source FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item WHERE NOT COALESCE((amount_usd IS NULL OR amount_usd <= 100000 OR bank_changed_at IS NULL OR scheduled_date IS NULL OR datediff(CAST(scheduled_date AS DATE), CAST(bank_changed_at AS DATE)) < 0 OR datediff(CAST(scheduled_date AS DATE), CAST(bank_changed_at AS DATE)) > 14 OR (callback_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND callback_phone_source IN ('edgar_registrant', 'vendor_master_pre_window'))), false) LIMIT 500
